name: tia_import_aml
description: Import hardware from a CAx/AutomationML (.aml) file with CaxProvider.Import. dry_run=true (default) lists the AML devices and name conflicts without changing the project. The import cannot be undone through Openness; archive the project first (tia_archive_project).

conflict_option.description: What to do with devices whose names exist: move_to_parking_lot (default, keeps both), retain_tia_device (skip AML one) or overwrite_tia_device (replace).
